Defaults external finding offsets to Unicode code points

```rust title="Rust"
use xberg::extract_with_external_redaction;
use xberg::ExtractInput;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let input_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"bytes":[90,111,195,171,120,32,101,109,97,105,108,101,100,46],"filename":"external-findings-default.txt","kind":"bytes","mime_type":"text/plain"}"#).unwrap();
    let input = serde_json::from_value::<ExtractInput>(input_json).unwrap();
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let findings_json = r#"[{"entity_type":"inspection_person","start":0,"end":3,"score":0.99,"analysis_explanation":{"recognizer":"spacy"}}]"#;
    let offset_encoding: Option<String> = None;
    let max_findings = Some(8);
    let result = extract_with_external_redaction(input, &config, findings_json, offset_encoding.as_deref(), max_findings).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.results[0].content);
}
```
